cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I know. Could you stay for the part that isn't the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit with me for nine. I don't want the last thing we fixed tonight to be the sink.

mechanism: A treats departure as something to authorize only after relationship talk, then grants a narrowly timed stay that respects the last bus.
confusable: D73 wants involvement as connection proof; D74 keeps an already-present person after the practical task ends to repair the relationship.
comparison: A limited bus window after washing dishes differs from choosing lateness before dinner with a partner who disclosed private debt.
seedUse: Use D74-a dishes finished and nine-of-ten-minutes solution; give the insistence a consistent permission-granting form.
